sloka: यद् आचरति कल्याणि शुभम् वा यदि वा अशुभम् ।तत् एव लभते भद्रे कर्ता कर्मजम् आत्मनः ॥२-६३-६॥
transliteration: yad ācarati kalyāṇi śubham vā yadi vā aśubham ।tat eva labhate bhadre kartā karmajam ātmanaḥ ॥2-63-6॥

translations.english: O gentle auspicious lady a man has to reap the fruit of his action, good or evil.
